video_prompt: One continuous horizontal full-frame shot from the first frame to the last, filmed on a phone front camera on a tripod. The woman — a woman about 28 years old with deep brown skin and a medium-length natural curly afro, small silver stud earrings, wearing a mustard-yellow ribbed knit top with a round neck — sits alone in a bright clean kitchen with white cabinets and a light wooden countertop behind her, a bowl of lemons and green apples on the counter, a hanging pothos plant, a white tiled backsplash, soft daylight, and stays exactly the same person the whole time: same face, same hair, same clothes, same position in the frame, same distance from the camera. The camera stays still and the room around her stays still and calm. She talks straight into the camera, sincere and a little worried, like confiding in a friend, with small natural head movements and small nods; her shoulders stay relaxed, her face stays centered in the frame, and between sentences her head settles back into the same upright, centered, front-facing resting pose she has in the first frame.
